column1: # Retirement dispositions for scripts/retirement/inventory.sh (P08.4). Hand-maintained; the generator only reads it.
# Columns separated by TABs: glob, owner, disposition, status, note. The first matching rule wins, so keep specific
# rules above general ones. Globs are relative to the repository root: * stays inside a directory, ** crosses them.
# Owners are component labels, not people. Disposition: retain | relocate | delete | archive. Status: proposed | accepted.
